reddit.title: Introducing a New Materials System for Building in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to our building mechanics! No longer will you see a single cost badge that obscures the actual materials needed for construction. Now, each build tile displays a comprehensive materials sheet showing both stored and required resources, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change will help you make informed decisions while planning your colony's expansion. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Revamped Building Materials System
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a new feature that enhances the building experience in Provincia! Our updated materials system allows you to view all required resources for each build tile at a glance. No more guessing what you need—now you can see stored versus required materials, with shortages clearly marked. This will help you plan your colony's growth more effectively. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
